policies.title: Deposits
policies.body: Some bookings need a small deposit to secure your spot. If yours does, I'll send you the details on WhatsApp once I've confirmed your appointment. The deposit comes off your final price.

policies.title: Cancelling or rescheduling
policies.body: Life happens — just let me know at least **24 hours** before your appointment and we'll find a new time. Cancellations with less notice, or no-shows, may lose the deposit.

policies.title: Running late
policies.body: Please let me know on WhatsApp if you're running late. If I'm more than 15 minutes late, I'll message you too. Very late starts may mean a simpler design so the next client isn't kept waiting.

policies.title: Payment
policies.body: Cash or EFT on the day. For EFT, please show proof of payment before I leave.
